_readme: Bellhide concept gate 02. Targeted response to gate 01, which rendered a large blue wolf wearing several complete bells.

Exactly one image. The single correction is structural: replace canine anatomy and attached household bells with a compact spring-legged creature whose back itself forms a broken resonant-metal mantle.
Do not animate, pixelize, create variants, or place it in the game until Raheem selects and refines a Leonardo concept.

design.label: Bellhide B — living resonant mantle
design.line: Orthographic side-elevation creature design: one single small recurring fantasy mob in an exact flat side-on profile facing right, with only one eye visible, its entire body and all four feet visible. The creature is squat and low to the ground, hairless, charcoal-blue, with a broad wedge-shaped head, no external ears, no horns and a short blunt mouth. Its shorter sturdy forelegs and enormous folded spring-like hind legs make it visibly built to crouch and leap. The creature's BACK ITSELF has grown into one continuous ancient cast-bronze resonant mantle, not armor strapped onto an animal. This mantle is asymmetrical and divided by deep cracks into three interlocking curved lobes; the lower edge flares outward in an irregular broken metal rim. There are absolutely no complete bells, no handles, no loops and nothing dangling from its back. Thin engraved rune channels follow the broken inner rim and glow turquoise-cyan; its one visible eye glows the same cyan. A short muscular tail curves underneath the rear rim and ends in a single heavy rounded bronze striking weight, integrated into the anatomy rather than hanging as an ornament. Compact waist-high enemy proportions, alert grounded idle pose, unusual but believable anatomy, charming enough to recur and solid enough to receive powerful magical impacts. Centered isolated full-body presentation on a plain warm neutral studio backdrop with generous empty space, no environment and no other objects.

review.title: Bellhide concept gate 02
review.lede: Judge whether the creature now has its own anatomy instead of reading as a wolf wearing bells. This is still Leonardo concept art, not the PixelLab sprite.
checklist: One compact creature in exact side profile
No wolf, dog or familiar mammal silhouette
No complete household bells or handles attached
The back itself forms one broken asymmetrical resonant-metal mantle
Spring-like legs make crouching and leaping believable
One cyan eye and cyan rune channels clearly share a magical identity
